description: Unity web framework layer — index.html with a real Unity loader shim (createUnityInstance, progress bar, early SharedArrayBuffer guard, error surface). Pairs with the unity-web-proxy family files (Vite dev server, tsconfig, batch-mode build script).

buildHints.whenToUse: Unity-authored games or interactive content that must ship as a browser-native WebGL build. This layer wires the HTML entry point — the family supplies the Vite dev server, tsconfig, and CI batch-mode build script.
firstSteps: Run `pnpm install` then `pnpm dev` — Vite serves on http://localhost:5173 with the COOP/COEP headers Unity 2021.2+ needs for SharedArrayBuffer.
Drop the Unity WebGL editor export into `Build/` — you need `Build.loader.js`, `Build.framework.js`, `Build.wasm`, and `Build.data` (filenames reflect Player Settings → Product Name).
If your Unity product name differs from `Build`, update the `buildUrl` constant and the `<script src>` in `index.html` to match.
Run `pnpm build` to produce a static `dist/` ready for any CDN — ensure the CDN also sets the COOP/COEP headers or threaded builds will fail.
gotchas: Unity 2021.2+ WebGL builds require `Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy: same-origin` and `Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy: require-corp` — without them the loader fails with a SharedArrayBuffer error. Vite's dev server is pre-configured; mirror these headers on the production host.

The loader filename in `index.html` (`Build/Build.loader.js`) is a placeholder matching the default build script output. It must exactly match the filename Unity writes, which is derived from Player Settings → Product Name.

Brotli/gzip-compressed Unity output (`.br` / `.gz` files) requires the server to send the correct `Content-Encoding` header; most static hosts strip it. Either disable compression in Unity Player Settings or verify headers with `curl -I` after deploy.
architectureNotes: index.html checks for `SharedArrayBuffer` before calling `createUnityInstance` and surfaces a human-readable error if missing — keeps the COOP/COEP misconfiguration failure mode visible instead of the opaque Unity loader panic.

The Unity canvas owns full-viewport layout via CSS `inset: 0` on `#unity-container` — do not add CSS transforms to `#unity-canvas` itself, as Unity resizes it via the API and external transforms are ignored.

placeholders.description: Loads Unity's WebGL bootstrap from ./Build/Build.loader.js. Update `buildUrl`, the `<script src>`, and the `companyName`/`productName` constants to match your Unity Player Settings after the first editor export.
